stands down without a forced take\u0022,\u0022AcceptanceCriteria\u0022:[\u0022h9k task assign \\u003Cid\\u003E --node \\u003Cnode-id or unambiguous fragment\\u003E records a node placement on the task non-placed node and claimed by the placed node; an unplaced task is unchanged; the refusal for an unknown node; a takeover rewrites the placement; no test creates branches or touches
